description: An agent-based simulation model to simulate the spread of mask-wearing behavior through social networks, considering individual attributes, social influence, and government interventions.

behaviors.name: adopt_mask_wearing
behaviors.description: Agents decide to wear a mask based on their susceptibility, social influence, and risk perception.

parameters.threshold: calculated from risk perception and social influence

behaviors.algorithm: If (social_influence + risk_perception) > threshold then set mask_wearing_status to True

behaviors.name: influence_others
behaviors.description: Agents influence others in their network to adopt mask-wearing behavior.
behaviors.algorithm: Increase social_influence of connected agents by influence_factor if wearing a mask

behaviors.name: propagate_influence
behaviors.description: The social network propagates influence between agents based on their connections.
behaviors.algorithm: Propagate influence through network with weights applied to connection types

interactions.name: Influence Interaction
interactions.description: Interaction where individuals influence each other's mask-wearing behavior based on social connections.
interactions.effect: Update social influence of connected agents

data_sources.name: agent_attributes.csv
data_sources.purpose: Initialize agent attributes and initial mask-wearing status

data_sources.name: social_network.json
data_sources.purpose: Define the social network structure and connections

data_sources.name: train_data.csv
data_sources.purpose: Train and calibrate the model based on historical data

files.name: main_simulation.py
files.description: Main simulation loop and control structure

files.name: agent.py
files.description: Defines the Person entity and behaviors

files.name: network.py
files.description: Defines the SocialNetwork entity and interactions

files.name: data_loader.py
files.description: Handles loading and preprocessing of data files

files.name: evaluation.py
files.description: Contains functions for evaluating simulation results
